characters.name: Margaret "Maggie" Pesky
characters.description: A pink-haired, energetic, self-expressive pre-teen fly whose dream is to become a superstar. Affectionate Nickname: She tends to be called "Mags". Badass Adorable: She defeats the giant, killer raccoon terrorizing Stickyfeet in the climax of "Racooooon!" Be a Whore to Get Your Man: Dresses up scandalously (in a G-rated way) at school to swoon her tutor Troy in "Hot for Tutor". Bratty Teenage Daughter: Often whines about her parents not letting her do what she wants despite their justification and authority. She'll also sometimes usePuppy-Dog Eyesto persuade them.

characters.name: Frieda Pesky
characters.description: Maggie's mother and Chauncey's husband, Frieda is a typical stay-at-home mom who does all the house chores and looks after Bella. Extreme Doormat: Like most housewife characters, she's often very sweet, cheerful, forgiving to abuse and her children's antics, and reluctant to punish them. This is especially shown in "Bugtillion", where she refuses to discipline Maggie despite her having initiated a plan with Rayna to embarrass and torment Dawn during her moment in the spotlight, on grounds that Maggie was trying to stand up for her best friend. Housewife: Her main occupation is being a stay-at-home wife.

characters.name: Aldrin Pesky
characters.description: Maggie's older brother and the eldest child of the Pesky family, Alrdin is a successful athlete on his school's football team and has a tendency to pick on his younger sister,though really does care for her deep down. The Ace: Well, if you’re the star quarterback and are able to throw a football, only to have the god-like ability to sprint fast enough to catch it yourself at the touchdown line, you’re pretty damn good to say the least.He combines this withJerk JockandBig Brother Bullyin his attitude towards younger siblings. He cares forBella, the baby of the family. He's the captain of all the high school sports teams, has at least one in-universe fangirl swooning over him at hisBurger Fooljob, and his teeth sparkle when he smiles. Partiallydeconstructedwhen Maggie wants to get a better part-time job than Aldrin (or at least let everyone think she has). Aldrin discovers the ruse and is FURIOUS that she would lie about her accomplishments when he worked very hard to get where he is (a later episode confirms how insanely hard his sports training routines are), but he still offers to recommend Maggie to the manager once she admits she was wrong. Usually, he's too much of anAloof Big Brotherto even bother giving advice, possibly because he'sThe Un-Favoritein their extended family, as Uncle Jeb blatantly favors Maggie (and later Pupert) and only compliments Aldrin when he realizes that gaining muscle mass means Aldrin can do more work. characters.name: Pupert Pesky
characters.description: Maggie's little brother who plays theAnnoying Younger Siblingrole to her and is a typical, innocently naïve child. The Baby of the Bunch: He's often rewarded and treated as a favorite child by his relatives due to simply being the younger and cuter one. Break the Cutie: In "Funball". The most painful of torment is inflicted upon him (seeButt-Monkey). Butt-Monkey: From time-to-time, most notably in "Funball", where is used as a basketball by Aldrin. The Ditz: Pupert isn't very wise. In "The Candidate", Dawn wins the homecoming queen award due to Pupert's miscalculations.

characters.name: Bella Pesky
characters.description: Maggie's baby sister who is still a maggot, and the youngest child of Mr. and Mrs. Pesky. Annoying Younger Sibling: To Maggie, more-so than Pupert. She causes Maggie's misfortunes in "Bella Con Carny". Brainy Baby: "Sister Act" shows her ability to breakdance, ballet, and juggle. A Day in the Limelight: "Sister Act" and "Bella Con Carny". Living Prop: Usually only appears to fill in the extra seat at the Pesky family dinner table. Justified, as she's just a baby and has little to say or do.

characters.name: Rayna Cartflight
characters.description: Maggie's best friend who appears to be a typicalSassy Black Woman. She's just as much of aGirly Girlas Maggie is, though is more intelligent and rational than her. Be a Whore to Get Your Man: As with Maggie, she dresses scandalously (in a G-rated way) to school to swoon her initial tutor in "Hot for Tutor". Childhood Friend: She and Maggie have been best friends since kindergarten. Elmuh Fudd Syndwome: Is shown to have had this in kindergarten in a flashback in "Best of Best Friends". Girly Girl: She's into music, fashion, shopping, boys etc., just as much as Maggie.

characters.name: Maria Monarch
characters.description: A monarch butterfly who moved to Stickyfeet because her father was tired of the whole "South America-to-North America thing". She was nerdy and unpopular at first, but that changed once Maggie and Rayna gave her a makeover. All for Nothing: She didn't need to have a makeover because taking off her glasses revealed her to beBeautiful All Along. Beautiful All Along: Even before her makeover she is stunningly beautiful, as shown when she takes off her glasses. Her acne clears up and her hairstyle even changes. Character Tics: Biting her fingernails, licking her hands, and making nasally oink-like sounds at the end of her sentences. Even the Girls Want Her: Maggie shows affection when Maria takes off her glasses, even going as far as to call her 'beautiful'. It doesn't help that an angelic orchestra plays during that scene.

characters.name: Dawn Swatworthy
characters.description: The most popular girl at Stickyfeet Middle, Dawn is anAlpha Bitchwho rivals Maggie and Rayna and has dreams of becoming a celebrity. She has two other popular blonde girls who back her up. Alpha Bitch: She is the most popular girl at Stickyfeet Middle and the leader of herGirl Posse. The Bad Guy Wins: She becomes Homecoming Queen in "The Candidate" due to Pupert's miscalculations. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: She acts as sweet as sugar when being Mr. Pestrip's principal aide, deceiving him into believing that she's aNice Girlwhodoes nothing wrong. Blatant Lies: She tells theseall the timeto get away with her actions. Just look at this exchange from "The Usual Insects":Rayna:Don't you think you'd remember if Maggie pulled a phony fire drill?Peststrip:I suppose so. Tell you what. I'll check with my new office aide. Dawn, could you come in here a moment, please?Maggie:Dawn?!Dawn:Yes, your principal-ness, sir?Peststrip:Oh, my.(clears throat)Uh, I need to know if there have been any unauthorized changes to the permanent record of late.Dawn:(sweetly)Not that I know of, sir.Maggie:She's lying! She put those totally untrue things into our records!All:Yeah!Maggie:Sir, Dawn's responsible.Peststrip:Dawn, is this true?Dawn:Gosh, I don't know. Maybe you should check my permanent record.Peststrip:Hm. Hm. It says here, "Dawn would never change a permanent record." Well, I guess that settles it.

characters.name: Eugene and Wendell
characters.description: Two twin beetles who seem to be the school's nerdiest kids. Those Two Guys: They're seen together in every scene they appear in.

characters.name: Gym Shorts Kid
characters.description: A geeky kid at Buzzdale Academy who constantly brings up his gym shorts. He has a notable crush on Dawn and is desperate for her attention, much to Dawn's disgust. Abhorrent Admirer: To Dawn. He consistenltly fawns over her and Dawn is usually weirded out by his attempts to woo her. Butt-Monkey: He's not the most popular kid at school... His geekiness and unkempt appearance oftentimes makes him a target for bullies. Plucky Comic Relief: He mostly exists to randomly bring up his gym shorts, right down to his name. Running Gag: Bringing up his gym shorts.

characters.name: George
characters.description: Aldrin's best friend and fellow football team member. He's not the exactly the brightest... Gasshole: He lets out a large, powerful burp in "The Hangout" after eating dozens of pizza. This happens not once, but twice. Third-Person Person: He usually refers to himself in third person.

characters.name: Lacey Ladybug
characters.description: A ladybug girl who transferred to Buzzdale Academy. She is very disrespectful towards flies andlikes to think that she's better than everyone else. Alliterative Name:LaceyLadybug. Alpha Bitch: She puts herself above flies and holds a grudge against them. Fantastic Racism: She discriminates against flies, even going as far as forcing the flies to wear ladybug wings. Laser-Guided Karma:Maggie reveals that she lied about her "luxurious" lifestyle and that her dad is a mayor of a fast-food restaurant.
